title: Rib and Leaf Combinations
summary: Joins rib and leaf work into short combinations that end in a qi crescent or a weapon-breaking beat.

title: The Qi-Spread Fan Treatise
summary: Teaches how qi spread through the leaf makes a barrier and a thrown crescent for field-stage cultivators.

title: Thrown Fan and Recall Handbook
summary: Teaches the short toss the skimming throw and the qi recall that brings the fan home.

title: Advanced Studies of the Armored Fan
summary: Teaches the heavy steel-faced fan as armor-breaking weapon and rotating shield for field-stage fighters.

title: Paired Fans of the Azure Court
summary: Teaches the paired fan forms of the azure court from the crossed guard to the twin crescent sweep.

title: The Twin-Fan Hawk Treatise
summary: Sets out how two fans act as a hawk's wings in the stoop the dive throw and the cover.

title: River-Basin Fan Forms
summary: Teaches fan forms that follow the bends and eddies of a river for students of the basin schools.

title: Dual-Track Fan Canon
summary: Trains the two fans along separate tracks that meet at the target in a piercing line or crescent.

title: The Wind-Sworn Fan Book
summary: Teaches wind-sworn fan work on open ground from the plateau stance to the great gale sweep.

title: The Plateau Fan Treatise
summary: Sets out plateau rim fan work that takes a bearing and holds it from first guard to the gale surge.

title: Fan Forms of the Taken Bearing
summary: Teaches the fan used windward and leeward with a bearing fixed first and kept through every form.

title: Gale Oath Fan Canon
summary: Sets out the oath fan from the ground guard to the oath gale sweep for field-stage students.
